source: https://www.luso-sabores.ch/ (the review slider on the home page, three slides)
note: The quotes stay in French in every language, as the guests wrote them; the translations below are marked as translations. No other reviews, ratings, averages or counts.

reviews.quote: C'était ma première expérience culinaire portugaise. Très bon et très bon marché.
reviews.name: Talios

translation.en: It was my first Portuguese culinary experience. Very good and very good value.
translation.pt: Foi a minha primeira experiência culinária portuguesa. Muito bom e muito barato.
translation.it: È stata la mia prima esperienza culinaria portoghese. Molto buono e molto economico.
translation.de: Es war mein erstes portugiesisches kulinarisches Erlebnis. Sehr gut und sehr günstig.
